scope: Initial BUY signal provenance for execution-clock sizing research
correction: V8.5 patch-chain already provides an append-like v8_trade_journal_signals table. The original v0.1 conclusion that exact formal trigger price was not durable was too broad.

v8TradeJournalSignals.writeOrder: called immediately after episode-specific signalId is built, before push suppression/reservation/send
v8TradeJournalSignals.marketPriceSemantics: result.currentPrice at formal signal occurrence; valid as formal SIGNAL price, not fill price
v8TradeJournalSignals.signalSharesSemantics: signal.shares from operationSignal / plan; for BUY this is precomputed plan firstShares, not buildPushPayload suggestedShares recomputed at currentPrice
v8TradeJournalSignals.deliverySemantics: row existence proves signal occurrence, not push acceptance
v8TradeJournalSignals.failureSemantics: write failure logs warning and signal/push can continue; absence cannot prove no signal
v8TradeJournalSignals.readbackSemantics: /api/journal reads up to 6000 signal rows for <=365 days with no truncation flag; bulk absence/completeness is not guaranteed
v8TradeJournalSignals.healthSemantics: /api/journal/health exposes signalCount but does not establish expected per-plan monitor completeness

otherStores.v7SignalDeliveryState: authoritative mutable lease/dedupe state; successful pending delivery record is removed
otherStores.lastMonitorKv: single overwritten latest monitor mirror with 2-day TTL
otherStores.cronRuns: append-only run metadata but detail stores status text, not per-plan result coverage

evidenceBoundary.positiveBuyRow: STRONG POSITIVE evidence that formal BUY occurred at persisted market_price/occurred_at.
evidenceBoundary.missingBuyRow: UNKNOWN unless independent plan-level monitor/recorder completeness is proven.
evidenceBoundary.barReconstruction: context only; 15m bar time/close cannot substitute for the contemporaneous quote market_price.
evidenceBoundary.signalShares: not exact live suggestedShares; counterfactual orderability must recompute shares using observed market_price.
